description: This file defines a class 'DetailedProjectActivityReportMenuConfigurator' implementing the 'MenuConfigurator' interface. It is responsible for configuring menu options within the OrangeHRM Time module, specifically overriding the screen to 'displayProjectReportCriteria' in the context of generating detailed project activity reports.

classes.name: DetailedProjectActivityReportMenuConfigurator
classes.description: A class responsible for configuring menu options for the detailed project activity report within the OrangeHRM Time module.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the screen to 'displayProjectReportCriteria' for the current module and screen context.
